consequence.statement: The release note announces a new additive capability (workload identity for remote clusters) and states no change to existing behavior, so an operator has no forced action or breakage implied by this item.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds workload identity support for remote clusters (RFC-0010) as a new capability.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The release note names no enabling mechanism (no flag, chart value, field, annotation, or gate is identified), so no environment condition can identify which environments are exposed to the new capability.
